title: Duelist (Dragon #73) for 1e FRPG
description: An optional non-player duelist class for 1e FRPG, based on Arthur Collins' "The Duelist" (Dragon #73, May 1983): levels from Beginner to Grand Fencingmaster, d12 hit dice, fighter combat, armor class and combat bonuses against hand-held weapons, parrying the death blow, resistance to fear, identifying magic weapons and the Fencingmaster's school. Rules restated in plain words. Adds a Duelist tab and a rules compendium. Turn it on or off in Manage Modules.
